draft.subject: Photographing Aurora Strings' June 4 concert at Metro Concert Hall
draft.body: I saw Aurora Strings has a June 4 date at Metro Concert Hall coming up, and I'm writing to ask whether you've got photography sorted for that night. You know how I work by now: no flash, unobtrusive documentary coverage that neither the players nor the audience notice. I'd be glad to talk through your photography plans for the performance, and if you've already got someone on it, that's no trouble. I look forward to hearing from you.
